Eurocopter EC135.fact: With the new AGW, the maximum takeoff weight has been increased up to 265 lb (120 kg) and payload.

Eurocopter EC135.question: An external hook can be installed to carry underslung loads of up to _____ for cargo missions
Eurocopter EC135.fact: An external hook can be installed to carry underslung loads of up to 272 kg for cargo missions.

Eurocopter EC135.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Eurocopter EC135.question: In 2012, _____ magazine recognised the EC135 as being "the industry's best selling twin-engine helicopter"
Eurocopter EC135.fact: In 2012, Flying magazine recognised the EC135 as being "the industry's best selling twin-engine helicopter". Originally delivered to the North East Air Support Unit in April 1999, it was the first EC135 worldwide to attain 10,000 flying hours.

Eurocopter EC135.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping

Eurocopter EC135.fact: In 2013, it was reported that the EC135 was currently providing roughly 25% of the world's total emergency medic services flights, and that over 500 EC135s have been delivered to in an aeromedical configuration.

Eurocopter EC135.fact: In October 2014, the first EC135 air ambulance was delivered in the Chinese market.

Eurocopter EC135.subject: Indian Aviation & Shipping
Eurocopter EC135.question: In 2014, the _____ noted that there was potential for vibration-induced rotor cracking during autorotation training, shortening the life of the main rotor
Eurocopter EC135.fact: The German Army operates 19 H135s as basic trainers at the School of Army Aviation in Bückeburg. In 2014, the German Army noted that there was potential for vibration-induced rotor cracking during autorotation training, shortening the life of the main rotor.

Eurocopter EC135.fact: In December 2014, the first production EC135 T3 entered service with Aiut Alpin Dolomites, a mountain rescue operator based in Italy.

Eurocopter EC135.question: On 28 August 2023, a _____'s Office EC135 crashed into a residential building, after witnesses stated it started smoking heavily while in flight before spinning and rapidly losing altitude
Eurocopter EC135.fact: On 28 August 2023, a Broward Sheriff's Office EC135 crashed into a residential building, after witnesses stated it started smoking heavily while in flight before spinning and rapidly losing altitude. A Broward Sheriff Fire Rescue Captain, and a resident of the structure that the helicopter crashed into, were both killed in the crash.
